units.source_text: 源氏公子展拜皇陵，似觉父皇在世时种种情状历历在目。

en.t: Prince Genji paid his respects at the imperial mausoleum, and it seemed that every scene from his father's lifetime rose vividly before his eyes.

units.source_text: 这位尊荣无极的明主，也已成了与世长辞之人，悼惜之情，不可言喻。

en.t: This wise sovereign of boundless honor and glory had also become one who had departed forever from the world, and Genji's grief and longing were beyond words.

units.source_text: 他在墓前啼啼哭哭，申诉了千言万语。

en.t: Before the grave, he wept and wept, pouring out countless words of sorrow and appeal.

units.source_text: 然而现已不能听到父皇的教诲。

en.t: Yet now he could no longer hear his father's instruction.

units.source_text: 不但如此，当时深思远虑而谆谆嘱咐的遗言，现在也不知消失在何方了！

en.t: More than that, even the last words his father had entrusted to him with such deep care and foresight now seemed to have vanished somewhere beyond knowing.
There was no use in speaking of such heartbreak.
